## OmniGrowth events
1. Set env: OMNIGROWTH_WEBHOOK_SECRET (the subscription secret), NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto.
2. Create an OmniGrowth subscription to this Webhook's production URL.
3. Replace the No-Op 'Notify' steps with your channel, then activate.
Events inform people; approving and publishing happen in OmniGrowth only.
